title: Synthesised check-in audio, which names her medications, defaults to /tmp/cura_audio
method: static read + instantiation, plus replay of synthesize()'s mkdir
observed_at_discovery: LocalTTS defaults output_dir='/tmp/cura_audio' and synthesize() does mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with no mode, then writes a fixed filename ('checkin.wav'). Observed default output_dir: /tmp/cura_audio; mkdir mode 0775 (0755 under umask 022). The audio is the check-in script read aloud, which names her medications. The path is fixed and guessable, so another account can pre-create or symlink it and exist_ok=True will write through. Rated low because piper-tts is optional and appears in neither requirements file, so this path does not execute on the first household. pytest exit 1, 2 failed.
